import: Geometry: import GroundReal_Flora.glb, GroundReal_Rocks.glb and GroundReal_Cliffs.glb (3D Importer / Open Cloud); each asset's 'glb' names its file. Each asset root arrives as a Model of MeshParts named <Asset>_<Role>[_n]; re-centre with the asset 'origin' (WorldPivot = CFrame.new(origin), then PivotTo) like the other categories. The GLBs carry tangents (MikkTSpace) and embedded textures (glb_only/*_MR.png is the packed glTF roughness; never upload it separately).

Surfaces: give every part ONE SurfaceAppearance from its 'surfaceAppearance' block: ColorMap / NormalMap / RoughnessMap = the uploaded image ids of those PNGs (upload each file in 'textures' once and share the ids so copies instance), MetalnessMap empty, AlphaMode as given, Color = 'color' (white: the maps are final albedo). Roughness PNGs are 8-bit grayscale; normal maps are OpenGL (+Y), tangent space. Clear any importer TextureID.
Cards (backFacesInMesh = true) already contain flipped back faces: keep MeshPart.DoubleSided = false and MeshPart.Transparency = 0 so AlphaMode Transparency is a depth-correct alpha cut-out.

Per part: CanCollide = collide, CollisionFidelity = collision (edit time only), CastShadow = castShadow, CanQuery = canQuery, CanTouch = canTouch, Anchored = true, Material = robloxMaterial (physics and footstep sounds only), Color = rgb (fallback when the SurfaceAppearance is not loaded).
BerryBush_Berries is a separate part: hide it when the bush is picked (Transparency 1 or parent it away).
Rocks and cliffs continue below y = 0 (buriedDepth) so they sit into terrain on slopes; plant cards sink at most 0.07. Place each asset's pivot on the terrain surface.

CliffFace* / CaveMouth use the tiling GR_Granite set: their UVs run outside 0..1 on purpose (the texture repeats every tileStuds studs). Check in Studio that the SurfaceAppearance repeats on these MeshParts.

notes: Flora: alpha cards with real flipped back faces (DoubleSided off, Transparency 0, AlphaMode Transparency); card bottoms are clamped to at most 0.07 studs below y = 0 so blades emerge from the soil on slopes.
Plants atlas: one-pixel alpha rim so thin blades survive the lower mips; colour is bled into every transparent pixel (no halos).

All roughness maps are separate 8-bit grayscale PNGs for the SurfaceAppearances; the GLBs embed a packed glTF metallicRoughness copy (glb_only/*_MR.png, R = G = roughness, B = 0, metallicFactor 0); no metal.
Rock texel density: RockPage1 53 px/stud, RockPage2 69 px/stud, RockPage3 69 px/stud, Granite tile 79 px/stud (1024 px over 13 studs)
